stories.title: Follow live: Rays retake lead over Yankees
White Sox beat Guardians to move within one win of ALCS
stories.summary: The White Sox beat the Guardians 4-3 on Monday to take a 2-0 lead in their AL Division Series.

stories.title: NFL suspends 2 officials for conduct toward players
stories.summary: The NFL has suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games for appearing to swear at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride. Referee Adrian Hill has been suspended one game for a separate incident in the Vikings' win over the Dolphins.

stories.title: Sources: Seahawks plan to sign RB Mixon with rookie Price on IR
stories.summary: The Seahawks plan to sign veteran running back Joe Mixon to their practice squad as long as he passes his physical, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Mariota has MCL sprain, Daniels set to practice this week, Quinn says
stories.summary: In his team's loss to the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday, Washington Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained MCL of his right knee, and the timetable for his return remains uncertain coach Dan Quinn said on Monday.
